evals.prompt: Create a NocoBase collection for tracking products with name, price, category, and stock quantity
evals.expected_output: curl command to collections:create with fields including type, interface, and uiSchema for each field
expectations: Each field has type, interface, and uiSchema
Uses decimal type for price with precision
Uses select interface for category with enum values

evals.prompt: Set up a belongsTo relation from orders to customers in NocoBase
evals.expected_output: curl commands creating belongsTo on orders and hasMany on customers
expectations: Creates belongsTo field on orders collection
Mentions creating the reverse hasMany on customers

evals.prompt: Design a self-referencing tree collection for categories with parent-child hierarchy
evals.expected_output: curl command creating collection with tree structure and self-referencing belongsTo/hasMany
expectations: Creates collection with tree adjacencyList option
Mentions tree=true query parameter for nested results
